sketch_steps: setup: Introduce the real unknown x.
forward: Assume 2*x + 3 = 11.
solve: Subtract 3 and divide by 2.
reverse: Substitute x = 4 into the original equation.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness: example (x : ℝ) : 2*x + 3 = 11 ↔ x = 4 := by constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Add the two equations to find x, then substitute back to find y.

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, (x - 2)*(x + 1) = 0 if and only if x = 2 or x = -1.
equation_and_inequality_cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="equivalent"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="times"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="minus"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>2</OMI></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>1</OMI></OMA></OMA><OMI>0</OMI></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="or"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>2</OMI></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="unary_minus"/><OMI>1</OMI></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Factor the quadratic and use the zero-product property.
sketch_steps: setup: View the left side as a product of two linear factors.
forward: Apply the zero-product property.
case_1: Solve x - 2 = 0.
case_2: Solve x + 1 = 0.
reverse: Substitute either root into one factor.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness:
example (x : ℝ) : (x - 2)*(x + 1) = 0 ↔ x = 2 ∨ x = -1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · left; linarith
    · right; linarith
  · rintro (h | h)
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, x^2 = 4 if and only if x = 2 or x = -2.

equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Rewrite x^2 - 4 as (x - 2)(x + 2), then apply the zero-product property.
sketch_steps: setup: Move 4 to the left side.
factor: Factor x^2 - 4 as (x - 2)(x + 2).
forward: Apply the zero-product property.
cases: Solve the two linear factor equations.
reverse: Check each proposed root.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness:
example (x : ℝ) : x^2 = 4 ↔ x = 2 ∨ x = -2 := by
  constructor

    · left; linarith
    · right; linarith
  · rintro (h | h)
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, (x - 3)^2 = 0 if and only if x = 3.

equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: A square is zero precisely when its base is zero.
sketch_steps: setup: Recognize a squared linear expression.
forward: Use that a zero square has zero base.
solve: Rearrange x - 3 = 0.
reverse: Substitute x = 3 and evaluate the square.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness:
example (x : ℝ) : (x - 3)^2 = 0 ↔ x = 3 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz : x - 3 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp h
    linarith
  · intro h
    subst x
    norm_num

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, x^2 - 6*x + 10 is not equal to 0.
equation_and_inequality_cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="not"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="minus"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="power"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>2</OMI></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="times"/><OMI>6</OMI><OMV name="x"/></OMA></OMA><OMI>10</OMI></OMA><OMI>0</OMI></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Complete the square: x^2 - 6*x + 10 = (x - 3)^2 + 1, which is positive.
sketch_steps: setup: Assume the quadratic equals zero for contradiction.
rewrite: Complete the square around x = 3.
bound: Use (x - 3)^2 ≥ 0.
contradict: Deduce the expression is at least 1.
conclude: No real root exists.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness: example (x : ℝ) : ¬ (x^2 - 6*x + 10 = 0) := by intro h; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 3)]

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For all real x and y, x^2 + y^2 = 0 if and only if x = 0 and y = 0.

equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Both squares are nonnegative; a sum of two nonnegative values can be zero only when each is zero.
sketch_steps: setup: Assume x^2 + y^2 = 0.
bound: Record x^2 ≥ 0 and y^2 ≥ 0.
separate: Deduce each square equals zero.
solve: Infer x = 0 and y = 0.
reverse: Substitute the zero pair.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness:
example (x y : ℝ) : x^2 + y^2 = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∧ y = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx2 : x^2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg y]
    have hy2 : y^2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg y]
    constructor
    · exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hx2
    · exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hy2
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    simp [hx, hy]

equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Expand the gap between the square of the arithmetic mean and the product as (x - y)^2 / 4.

bound: Use (x - y)^2 ≥ 0.

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, |x - 3| ≤ 2 if and only if 1 ≤ x and x ≤ 5.
equation_and_inequality_cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="equivalent"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="leq"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="abs"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="minus"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>3</OMI></OMA></OMA><OMI>2</OMI></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="leq"/><OMI>1</OMI><OMV name="x"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="leq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>5</OMI></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Use the characterization |u| ≤ a iff -a ≤ u and u ≤ a, then shift the interval by 3.
sketch_steps: setup: Set u = x - 3.
forward: Expand |u| ≤ 2 into two linear bounds.
shift: Add 3 to both bounds.
reverse: Start from 1 ≤ x ≤ 5.
conclude: Shift back and apply the absolute-value characterization.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness:
example (x : ℝ) : |x - 3| ≤ 2 ↔ 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 5 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases (abs_le.mp h) with ⟨h1, h2⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩

equation_and_inequality_cards.canonical_statement: For every real x, if x is not equal to -1 and x/(x + 1) = 1/2, then x = 1.
equation_and_inequality_cards.openmath_xml: <OMOBJ xmlns="http://www.openmath.org/OpenMath" version="2.0"><OMBIND><OMS cd="quant1" name="forall"/><OMBVAR><OMV name="x"/></OMBVAR><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="set1" name="in"/><OMV name="x"/><OMS cd="setname1" name="R"/></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="implies"/><OMA><OMS cd="logic1" name="and"/><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="neq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="unary_minus"/><OMI>1</OMI></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="divide"/><OMV name="x"/><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="plus"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>1</OMI></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="arith1" name="divide"/><OMI>1</OMI><OMI>2</OMI></OMA></OMA></OMA><OMA><OMS cd="relation1" name="eq"/><OMV name="x"/><OMI>1</OMI></OMA></OMA></OMA></OMBIND></OMOBJ>
equation_and_inequality_cards.proof_strategy: Check the denominator, clear it safely, and solve the resulting linear equation.
sketch_steps: setup: Assume x ≠ -1 so x + 1 is nonzero.
clear_denominator: Multiply x/(x + 1) = 1/2 by x + 1.
simplify: Normalize the constant fraction 1/2.
solve: Rearrange the resulting linear equation.
conclude: Obtain x = 1.
equation_and_inequality_cards.lean_witness:
example (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ -1) (h : x / (x + 1) = 1 / 2) : x = 1 := by
  have hden : x + 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hx
    linarith
  rw [div_eq_iff hden] at h
  norm_num at h
  linarith
